title: EarlySelectKV: Anticipatory KV Selection via Cross-Layer Query Proxies
abstract: arXiv:2611.01715v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Query-conditioned sparse KV selection reduces long-context inference cost by attending to a subset of historical KV entries at each decoding step. Existing selectors must wait for the target-layer query before scoring candidates and generating indices, placing routing on the immediate pre-attention path. We introduce EarlySelectKV, a training-free transformation that uses proxy queries from earlier hidden states to precompute selected KV indices while retaining the real target-layer query for final attention. Tests with RocketKV, Quest, and Loki show no consistent pattern of quality degradation across the evaluated settings. In the primary RocketKV evaluation, ES-RocketKV differs by +0.018 points on LongBench, approximately -0.01 points on RULER, and +0.25 percentage points on representative NIAH/Passkey settings. In a TensorRT-LLM deployment with CPU-offloaded routing, ES-RocketKV improves end-to-end output throughput by up to 12.4% and

translated_title: EarlySelectKV：基于跨层查询代理的预判式KV选择
translated_abstract: 查询条件化的稀疏KV选择通过在每个解码步骤中仅关注历史KV条目的子集来降低长上下文推理成本。现有的选择器必须等待目标层的查询才能对候选进行评分并生成索引，这使得路由过程被置于注意力计算之前的紧邻路径上。我们提出了EarlySelectKV，这是一种无需训练的转换方法，它利用来自较早隐藏状态的代理查询来预计算所选的KV索引，同时在最终注意力计算中保留真实的目标层查询。在RocketKV、Quest和Loki上的测试显示，在所有评估设置中均未出现一致的质量退化模式。在主要的RocketKV评估中，ES-RocketKV在LongBench上相差+0.018分，在RULER上约为-0.01分，在代表性的NIAH/Passkey设置上为+0.25个百分点。在采用CPU卸载路由的TensorRT-LLM部署中，ES-RocketKV将端到端输出吞吐量提升了高达12.4%。
tldr: EarlySelectKV利用较早层的隐藏状态作为代理查询来提前预计算KV索引选择，使稀疏KV路由脱离注意力计算前的关键路径，在几乎不损失质量的情况下将端到端输出吞吐量提升高达12.4%。
en_tdlr: EarlySelectKV uses proxy queries from earlier hidden states to precompute KV index selections off the critical pre-attention path, improving end-to-end output throughput by up to 12.4% with negligible quality degradation.
